title: Put dollar figures on five risks and check four systems against recovery targets
situation: Leadership wants the risk register in dollars before budget season. Five risks are on the list, from a customer database breach to a flood at the data center to an old anonymous file-transfer server partners still use. We also need to know whether payroll, the website, the legacy ERP (enterprise resource planning) system and the sign-in service can recover as fast as the business needs.
your_task: Calculate the single loss and yearly expected loss for each risk.
Compare treatment options by net yearly benefit and pick a treatment for each risk.
Place each risk on the 5-by-5 likelihood and impact heat map.
Check each system's backups, restore time and availability against its targets.
why_it_matters: Without dollar figures, money goes to the scariest-sounding risk instead of the most expensive one. A system that cannot be restored in time can stop payroll or sales.
done_when: Total expected loss of $631,000 a year drops to $58,800 after the chosen treatments.
Each risk has a treatment: 2 mitigate, 1 transfer, 1 accept and 1 avoid.
The accepted risk ($5,000 a year) is shown to be within the $10,000 risk appetite and needs the owner's sign-off.
Payroll and the legacy ERP system are flagged as failing their recovery targets.

glossary.Single loss expectancy (SLE): How much one occurrence of the risk would cost.
glossary.Annualized rate of occurrence (ARO): How many times a year the risk is expected to happen.
glossary.Annualized loss expectancy (ALE): Expected yearly cost of the risk: single loss times yearly rate.
glossary.Recovery point objective (RPO): The most data, in hours, the business can afford to lose.
glossary.Recovery time objective (RTO): How fast a system must be working again after an outage.
glossary.Mean time between failures (MTBF) / mean: How long a system usually runs before failing, and how long it usually takes to fix.
glossary.Risk appetite: The amount of risk leadership is willing to live with.

talking_point: Quantified 5 risks at $631,000 in expected yearly loss, recommended treatments that cut it to $58,800, and found 2 of 4 critical systems failing their recovery targets.
